admin.blocked_usernames_help: One username per line. Matching is not case sensitive. Use * as a wildcard, for example "admin*" blocks "admin", "admin1" and "administrator". Administrators are not affected by this list.
admin.message_help: Shown to a person who tries to register with a blocked username. Leave empty to use the default message.
admin.message_placeholder: This username is not available. Please choose another one.

api.default_message: This username is not available. Please choose another one.
